\begin{theorem}
  Suppose $n \in \N$. Then $n+0=n$.
\end{theorem}
\begin{proof}
  Adding zero preserves the natural number.
  \begin{lean}
    -- A typesetting specimen, excluded from textbook proof coverage.
    example (n : Nat) : n + 0 = n := by
      exact Nat.add_zero n
  \end{lean}
\end{proof}

\[
  \sum_{k=0}^{n} k = \frac{n(n+1)}{2}.
\]
